rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 3.82 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified. A 2007 completed felling overlaps only 0.01 ha (0.3%), so not ALREADY_FELLED.

Eleven eligible species (threatened, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound) are recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, and none within 250 m. They include the CR fungus Rhodotus palmatus (363 m), the EN fungus Steccherinum robustius (363 m), the EN lichen Megalaria laureri (472 m, 2024, uncertainty 10 m), and the VU beetles Rhizophagus brancsiki and Stictoleptura scutellata (355 m, 2018).

Several eligible records are recent (2024-2026), for example the VU lichens Porina leptalea (372 m, 2026) and Thelopsis rubella (428 m, 2024) and the VU fungus Rigidoporus obducens (372 m, 2026). The count of eligible species is high and the nearest records lie 355-440 m from the edge.
Site-bound forest NT species number 7 within 1000 m, but the tool output does not place 3 of them within 250 m, so the 3-NT criterion is not shown to be met.

Effort is adequate and high (1554 records within 1000 m vs county median 136). Near-site there are 0 records inside the polygon and 12 records of 10 species on 3 days within 250 m. 68 coarse records within 250 m were excluded for uncertainty.

uncertainties: Several of the nearest eligible records (Rhodotus palmatus, Steccherinum robustius, Hypoxylon vogesiacum at 363 m) have coordinate uncertainty of 390 m, larger than the 250 m ring, so they cannot be placed within 250 m and may lie nearer or further than reported.
The 68 coarse records excluded within 250 m might include species that matter, so the lack of eligible records in that ring is weak.
25 red-listed species were not shown in the output; the tool counts give 11 eligible species in total.
Records show a species was recorded, not that it occupies this polygon today; some records date from 2018.
not_established: Whether any eligible red-listed species occurs on the notified polygon.
Stand age, dead wood or habitat quality.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should treat this as a high-attention MEDIUM site. Check the stand for old trees, dead wood and continuity forest, and check the position of the CR and EN fungi, which carry 390 m uncertainty, relative to the polygon.
